verdict.rationale: Phoenix is an LLM tracing platform, so masking or redacting sensitive span data before storage is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents OTLP ingestion, auto-instrumentation and tracing decorators, but nothing about masking, redaction, PII scrubbing or hiding inputs and outputs. Self-hosting that keeps data inside your own infrastructure is a related data-residency control, not redaction, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
